shellCommands.command: for f in $(find .next/server/app/projects -type f | sort); do echo "=== $f"; grep -c "Acme Storefront" "$f" 2>/dev/null; grep -c "Commerce storefront" "$f" 2>/dev/null; done
(timeout 120 npx next start -p 3111 > /tmp/next.log 2>&1 &) ; sleep 6; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" http://localhost:3111/

cd /workspace
echo "--- TREE prefetch"; curl -s "http://localhost:3111/projects/acme" -H 'RSC: 1' -H 'Next-Router-Prefetch: 1' -H 'next-router-segment-prefetch: /_tree' | tr -d '\0' | grep -o "Acme Storefront\|Commerce storefront" | sort -u
echo "--- PAGE segment prefetch"; curl -s "http://localhost:3111/projects/acme" -H 'RSC: 1' -H 'Next-Router-Prefetch: 1' -H 'next-router-segment-prefetch: /projects/$d$slug/__PAGE__' | tr -d '\0' | grep -o "Acme Storefront\|Commerce storefront" | sort -u
echo "--- full prefetch (auto, no segment header)"; curl -s "http://localhost:3111/projects/acme" -H 'RSC: 1' -H 'Next-Router-Prefetch: 1' | tr -d '\0' | grep -o "Acme Storefront\|Commerce storefront" | sort -u

cd /workspace
for seg in '/_tree' '/projects/$d$slug/__PAGE__'; do echo "=== $seg"; curl -s --compressed "http://localhost:3111/projects/acme" -H 'RSC: 1' -H 'Next-Router-Prefetch: 1' -H "next-router-segment-prefetch: $seg" -D /tmp/h.txt -o /tmp/body.bin; grep -i "^x-nextjs\|^content-\|^HTTP" /tmp/h.txt; wc -c /tmp/body.bin; strings /tmp/body.bin | grep -i "acme\|storefront\|Loading\|h1" | head -5; done

cd /workspace
probe() { curl -s --compressed "http://localhost:3111/projects/acme?_rsc=x" -H 'RSC: 1' -H 'Next-Router-Prefetch: 1' ${2:+-H "next-router-segment-prefetch: $2"} -o /tmp/b.bin -w "bytes=%{size_download} "; echo -n "$1: "; tr -d '\000' < /tmp/b.bin | grep -o "Acme Storefront\|Commerce storefront\|Loading details" | sort -u | tr '\n' ' '; echo; }
probe TREE '/_tree'
probe PAGESEG '/projects/$d$slug/__PAGE__'
probe FULLPREFETCH ''

cd /workspace
probe() { local out; out=$(curl -sL --compressed "http://localhost:3111/projects/acme" -H 'RSC: 1' -H 'Next-Router-Prefetch: 1' ${2:+-H "next-router-segment-prefetch: $2"} -o /tmp/b.bin -w "%{size_download}"); echo -n "$1 (bytes=$out): "; tr -d '\000' < /tmp/b.bin | grep -o "Acme Storefront\|Commerce storefront\|Loading details" | sort -u | tr '\n' ' '; echo; }
probe TREE '/_tree'
probe PAGESEG '/projects/$d$slug/__PAGE__'
probe AUTO_NOSEG ''

cd /workspace; pkill -f "next start" ; sleep 1; (timeout 180 npx next start -p 3112 > /tmp/next2.log 2>&1 &) ; sleep 6
probe() { local out; out=$(curl -sL --compressed "http://localhost:3112/projects/acme" -H 'RSC: 1' ${1:+-H 'Next-Router-Prefetch: 1'} ${2:+-H "next-router-segment-prefetch: $2"} -o /tmp/b.bin -w "%{size_download}"); echo -n "bytes=$out : "; tr -d '\000' < /tmp/b.bin | grep -o "Acme Storefront\|Commerce storefront\|Loading details" | sort -u | tr '\n' ' '; echo; }
echo -n "PREFETCH page segment  "; probe 1 '/projects/$d$slug/__PAGE__'
echo -n "PREFETCH (no seg hdr)  "; probe 1 ''
echo -n "NAVIGATION (full RSC)  "; probe '' ''

cd /workspace; (timeout 180 npx next start -p 3113 > /tmp/next3.log 2>&1 &) ; sleep 6
probe() { local out; out=$(curl -sL --compressed "http://localhost:3113/projects/acme" -H 'RSC: 1' ${1:+-H 'Next-Router-Prefetch: 1'} ${2:+-H "next-router-segment-prefetch: $2"} -o /tmp/b.bin -w "%{size_download}"); echo -n "bytes=$out : "; tr -d '\000' < /tmp/b.bin | grep -o "Acme Storefront\|Commerce storefront\|Loading details" | sort -u | tr '\n' ' '; echo; }
echo -n "PREFETCH page segment  "; probe 1 '/projects/$d$slug/__PAGE__'
echo -n "PREFETCH (no seg hdr)  "; probe 1 ''
echo -n "NAVIGATION (full RSC)  "; probe '' ''

cd /workspace for s in acme orbit unknown; do echo -n "prefetch /projects/$s : "; curl -sL --compressed "http://localhost:3113/projects/$s" -H 'RSC: 1' -H 'Next-Router-Prefetch: 1' -H 'next-router-segment-prefetch: /projects/$d$slug/__PAGE__' -o /tmp/b.bin -w "%{size_download}b "; tr -d '\000' < /tmp/b.bin | grep -o "Acme Storefront\|Orbit Analytics\|Unknown project\|Commerce storefront\|Product analytics\|Loading details" | sort -u | tr '\n' ' '; echo; done echo echo "-- full page load timings (first byte vs total) --" curl -s -o /tmp/p.html -w "acme html: ttfb=%{time_starttransfer}s total=%{time_total}s\n" http://localhost:3113/projects/acme grep -o "

[^<]*

\|Commerce storefront\|Loading details" /tmp/p.html | sort -u
cd /workspace; pkill -f "next start" >/dev/null 2>&1; cat .gitignore; git status --short
